title: Goal definition and milestone seed
purpose: Turn an approved business or engineering intent into a bounded goal candidate with scope, authority, evidence requirements, and candidate milestones for human approval.

input_contract.name: goal_intent
input_contract.description: Sanitised outcome the user wants to achieve.

input_contract.name: available_evidence
input_contract.description: Approved repository references and constraints relevant to the goal.

output_contract.name: goal_candidate
output_contract.description: Structured candidate with outcome, scope, non-goals, success criteria, authority needs, and milestones.

constraints: Treat the outcome as a candidate until a human records explicit approval.
Separate scope, non-goals, dependencies, proof requirements, and stop conditions.
Do not include secrets, customer data, raw prompt executions, or hidden reasoning.

rendering.template: Using only the approved intent and evidence references, produce a goal candidate with desired outcome, scope, non-goals, success criteria, proof requirements, dependencies, authority required, risks, and candidate milestones. Mark it pending human approval. Do not invent evidence or include private execution content.
